The '''XF-16 power generator''' was manufactured by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]] sometime in between pre-[[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> Four were used on [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']],<ref name="FF26" /> a modified [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]],<ref name="TechPlate">[["Slave 1" TechPlate]] provides the full name for the Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft.''</ref> owned by the infamous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="FF26" />
